newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX crude holds London levels but seen down.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX crude holds London levels but seen down.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures were untraded at midday in Asia on Thursday, holding London's OPEC inspired gains from overnight.

August was quoted at $18.02/$18.25 per barrel, after London rose 35 cents to $18.22 following OPEC ministerial comments that the group would freeze its supply ceiling of 25.033 million barrels per day and would adhere to quotas after months of over production.

However, brokers in Asia said the rise was a knee jerk reaction built on headline trading. They were sceptical the gains would hold, citing London's pull back from an intraday high of $18.45 as evidence the gains would be short lived.
NYMEX August crude futures closed in New York at $19.52 per barrel, up 49 cents. They edged down on ACCESS to last trade at $19.50 per barrel, down two cents from New York.
